body.p: COUNCIL DIRECTIVE 94/4/EC

p.style: font-weight: bold; text-align: center; margin-bottom: 6pt; margin-top: 0pt

body.p: of 14 February 1994

p.style: font-weight: bold; text-align: center; margin-bottom: 6pt; margin-top: 0pt

body.p: amending Directives 69/169/EEC and 77/388/EEC and increasing the level of allowances for travellers from third countries and the limits on tax-free purchases in intra-Community travel

p.style: font-family: 'Arial Unicode MS'; font-size: 10pt; text-align: justify; margin-top: 6pt; margin-bottom: 6pt

div.p: THE COUNCIL OF THE EUROPEAN UNION,

p.style: font-family: 'Arial Unicode MS'; font-size: 10pt; text-align: justify; margin-top: 6pt; margin-bottom: 6pt

div.p: Having regard to the Treaty establishing the European Community, and in particular Article 99 thereof,

p.style: font-family: 'Arial Unicode MS'; font-size: 10pt; text-align: justify; margin-top: 6pt; margin-bottom: 6pt
font-family: 'Arial Unicode MS'; font-size: 10pt; text-align: justify; margin-top: 6pt; margin-bottom: 6pt
font-family: 'Arial Unicode MS'; font-size: 10pt; text-align: justify; margin-top: 6pt; margin-bottom: 6pt
font-family: 'Arial Unicode MS'; font-size: 10pt; text-align: justify; margin-top: 6pt; margin-bottom: 6pt
font-family: 'Arial Unicode MS'; font-size: 10pt; text-align: justify; margin-top: 6pt; margin-bottom: 6pt

div.p: Whereas the total value of the goods eligible for this exemption may not exceed ECU 45 per person; whereas, in accordance with Article 1 (2) of Directive 69/169/EEC, Member States may reduce the allowance to ECU 23 for travellers under 15 years of age;

p.style: font-family: 'Arial Unicode MS'; font-size: 10pt; text-align: justify; margin-top: 6pt; margin-bottom: 6pt

div.p: Whereas account must be taken of measures in favour of travellers recommended by specialized international organizations, in particular the measures contained in Annex F.3 to the International Convention on the Simplification and Harmonization of Customs Procedures;

p.style: font-family: 'Arial Unicode MS'; font-size: 10pt; text-align: justify; margin-top: 6pt; margin-bottom: 6pt

div.p: Whereas these objectives could be attained by increasing the allowances;

p.style: font-family: 'Arial Unicode MS'; font-size: 10pt; text-align: justify; margin-top: 6pt; margin-bottom: 6pt

div.p: Whereas it is necessary to provide, for a limited period, a derogation for Germany, taking into account the economic difficulties likely to be caused by the amount of the allowances, particularly as regards travellers entering the territory of that Member State by land frontiers linking Germany to countries other than Member States and the EFTA members or by means of coastal navigation coming from the said countries;

p.style: font-family: 'Arial Unicode MS'; font-size: 10pt; text-align: justify; margin-top: 6pt; margin-bottom: 6pt

div.p: Whereas there are special links between continental Spain and the Canary Islands, Ceuta and Melilla;

p.style: font-family: 'Arial Unicode MS'; font-size: 10pt; text-align: justify; margin-top: 6pt; margin-bottom: 6pt
font-family: 'Arial Unicode MS'; font-size: 10pt; text-align: justify; margin-top: 6pt; margin-bottom: 6pt
font-style: italic; text-align: center; margin-top: 12pt; margin-btoom: 6pt

body.p: Article 1

p.style: font-family: 'Arial Unicode MS'; font-size: 10pt; text-align: justify; margin-top: 6pt; margin-bottom: 0pt

body.p: Directive 69/169/EEC is hereby amended as follows:

p.style: font-family: 'Arial Unicode MS'; font-size: 10pt; text-align: justify; margin-top: 6pt; margin-bottom: 0pt

div.p: 1. in Article 1 (1), ‘ECU 45’ shall be replaced by ‘ECU 175’;

p.style: font-family: 'Arial Unicode MS'; font-size: 10pt; text-align: justify; margin-top: 6pt; margin-bottom: 0pt

div.p: 2. in Article 1 (2), ‘ECU 23’ shall be replaced by ‘ECU 90’;

p.style: font-family: 'Arial Unicode MS'; font-size: 10pt; text-align: justify; margin-top: 6pt; margin-bottom: 0pt

div.p: 3. Article 7b shall be replaced by the following:

p.style: margin-left: 12pt; font-family: 'Arial Unicode MS'; font-size: 10pt; text-align: justify
font-style: italic; text-align: LEFT; margin-top: 12pt; margin-btoom: 6pt
font-family: 'Arial Unicode MS'; font-size: 10pt; text-align: justify; margin-top: 6pt; margin-bottom: 0pt

p.p: 1. By way of derogation from Article 1 (1), Spain is hereby authorized to apply, until 31 December 2000, an allowance of ECU 600 for imports of the goods in question by travellers coming from the Canary Islands, Ceuta and Melilla who enter the territory of Spain as definied in Article 3 (2) and (3) of Directive 77/388/EEC.

p.style: font-family: 'Arial Unicode MS'; font-size: 10pt; text-align: justify; margin-top: 6pt; margin-bottom: 0pt

p.p: 2. By way of derogation from Article 1 (2), Spain shall have the option of reducing that allowance to ECU 150 for travellers under 15 years of age.’

p.style: font-style: italic; text-align: center; margin-top: 12pt; margin-btoom: 6pt

body.p: Article 2

p.style: font-family: 'Arial Unicode MS'; font-size: 10pt; text-align: justify; margin-top: 6pt; margin-bottom: 0pt

body.p: In Article 28k of Directive 77/388/EEC, the first subparagraph of point 2 (a) shall be replaced by the following:

p.style: font-family: 'Arial Unicode MS'; font-size: 10pt; text-align: justify; margin-top: 6pt; margin-bottom: 0pt

div.p: ‘(a) the total value of which per person per journey does not exceed ECU 90.

p.style: margin-left: 12pt; font-family: 'Arial Unicode MS'; font-size: 10pt; text-align: justify

div.p: By way of derogation from Article 28m, Member States shall determine the equivalent in national currency of the above amount in accordance with Article 7 (2) of Directive 69/169/EEC.’

p.style: font-style: italic; text-align: center; margin-top: 12pt; margin-btoom: 6pt

body.p: Article 3

p.style: font-family: 'Arial Unicode MS'; font-size: 10pt; text-align: justify; margin-top: 6pt; margin-bottom: 0pt

body.p: 1. Member States shall bring into force the provisions necessary to comply with this Directive by 1 April 1994 at the latest. They shall forthwith inform the Commission thereof.

p.style: font-family: 'Arial Unicode MS'; font-size: 10pt; text-align: justify; margin-top: 6pt; margin-bottom: 0pt

body.p: When Member States adopt these provisions, they shall contain a reference to this Directive or shall be accompanied by such reference on the occasion of their official publication. The methods of making such a reference shall be laid down by the Member States.

p.style: font-family: 'Arial Unicode MS'; font-size: 10pt; font-weight: bold; text-align: left; margin-top: 6pt; margin-bottom: 0pt
font-family: 'Arial Unicode MS'; font-size: 10pt; text-align: justify; margin-top: 6pt; margin-bottom: 0pt

body.p: 2. By way of derogation from paragraph 1, the Federal Republic of Germany and the Republic of Austria shall be authorised to bring into force the measures necessary to comply with this Directive by 1 January 2003 at the latest for goods imported by travellers entering German or Austrian territory by a land frontier linking Germany or Austria to countries other than Member States and the EFTA members or, where applicable, by means of coastal navigation coming from the said countries.

p.style: font-family: 'Arial Unicode MS'; font-size: 10pt; text-align: justify; margin-top: 6pt; margin-bottom: 0pt

body.p: However, those Member States shall apply an allowance of not less than ECU 100 from 1 January 1999 to imports by the travellers referred to in the preceding subparagraph. They shall jointly increase that amount gradually, with a view to applying the limit in force in the Community to the said imports by 1 January 2003 at the latest.

p.style: font-family: 'Arial Unicode MS'; font-size: 10pt; font-weight: bold; text-align: left; margin-top: 6pt; margin-bottom: 0pt
font-family: 'Arial Unicode MS'; font-size: 10pt; text-align: justify; margin-top: 6pt; margin-bottom: 0pt

body.p: 3. Member States shall communicate to the Commission the text of the provisions of domestic law which they adopt in the field covered by this Directive.

p.style: font-style: italic; text-align: center; margin-top: 12pt; margin-btoom: 6pt

body.p: Article 4

p.style: font-family: 'Arial Unicode MS'; font-size: 10pt; text-align: justify; margin-top: 6pt; margin-bottom: 0pt

body.p: This Directive shall enter into force on the day of its publication in the Official Journal of the European Communities.

p.style: font-style: italic; text-align: center; margin-top: 12pt; margin-btoom: 6pt

body.p: Article 5

p.style: font-family: 'Arial Unicode MS'; font-size: 10pt; text-align: justify; margin-top: 6pt; margin-bottom: 0pt

body.p: This Directive is addressed to the Member States.
